Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Nation's largest insurance companies try to access HTVLIII test results to determine applicants' insurability 2. Rhode Island governor signs pro-gay legislation into law 3. Massachusetts House of Representatives defeats a gay rights bill, AIDS scare COMMERCIAL: NGTF Fund for Human Dignity with "Dear Abby" Abigail Van Buren 4. Racine, Wisconsin nurse loses job because of sexual orientation 5. Wisconsin QUEST Program starts housing program for low income gay and lesbian senior citizens 6. Episcopal church speaks out against AIDS anxiety 7. Federal government approves HPA23 for experimental use in the United States 8. Californian republican, congressman Robert Dornan speaks out against AIDS anxiety in The House of Representatives COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 8. Sports, includes clip 9. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Dr. Scott Croxson, Research Fellow, Beth Israel Medical Center, discusses AIDS related conflicts 10. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Interview with Candido Mendes, Director of Gay Parade Day, includes coverage of parade COMMERCIAL: Carnaval in Rio de Janeiro, Islanders' Club 2. Broadway Confidential, "After Hours," includes clip COMMERCIAL: GMHC Healthy Sex Workshops 3. Cabaret Beat, includes clip of Bradshaw Smith
